# Overview

VONQ’s current operations relevant to exit preparation and investor reporting involve the finance, commercial/CRM, data/analytics, and senior leadership teams. The company relies primarily on its Finance System, CRM, ERP, and Qlik Warehouse platforms for data management and reporting activities. Qlik Warehouse serves as the main data platform, with existing reporting and analytics functions powered by Qlik-based tools.

The key data sources integrated into the reporting environment include the Finance System, CRM, ERP, and the Qlik Warehouse, alongside legacy sources that may be required to provide at least three years of trended data. Excel-based datasets and certain external systems may also be considered, subject to feasibility and agreement. Batch processing is currently in use, and integration from some source systems into the Qlik Warehouse is manual, requiring one-off ingestion to establish data pipelines. Where periodic data refreshes are needed during the transaction, a recurring process will be set up to ensure timely updates across the reporting suite.
